The plate looks like a square side plate, about 20 cm across. It is about 450 px wide in the image, so roughly 0.045 cm per px... more precisely 20 cm / 450 px ≈ 0.044 cm/px.

The pineapple chunks are spread over roughly 250 px by 120 px. Each chunk is about 50 px, or about 2.2 cm, on its long side and about 1.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 2.2 × 1.8 × 1.5 ≈ 6 cm³ per chunk, or about 6 g.

I count about 9 chunks, which comes to about 54 g. Allowing for the stacked pieces I can't see fully, I'll estimate 55 g.
